description.en:
When Roman architect Lucius is criticized for his "outdated" thermae designs, he retreats to the local bath to collect his thoughts. All Lucius wants is to recapture the Rome of earlier days, when one could enjoy a relaxing bath without the pressure of merchants and roughhousing patrons. Slipping deeper into the warm water, Lucius is suddenly caught in the suction and dragged through the drainage at the bottom of the bath! He emerges coughing and sputtering amid a group of strange-looking foreigners with the most peculiar bathhouse customs…over 1,500 years in the future in modern-day Japan! His contemporaries wanted him to modernize, and so, borrowing the customs of these mysterious bath-loving people, Lucius opens what quickly becomes the most popular new bathhouse in Rome-Thermae Romae!

description.en:
Kazuya Kawaguchi has always had a crush on Miki Toda since elementary school, but every time he tries to give her a love letter to confess his feelings, he ends up turning away in fear. Several years later, the two meet at an alumni homecoming. Much to his dismay, Kazuya discovers that Miki doesn't remember who he is, and so puts up an act to hide the fact that the revelation has affected him so.   
Meanwhile, Miki garners a vague recollection of Kazuya, and so begins feeling similarly dismayed at the fact that he seemingly doesn't remember who she is, either. But just when Miki thinks the night will end in sheer frustration, Kazuya builds the courage to ask her out on a date. And so begins the awkwardly cute love story of these two incidental lovers, where everything started with a stack of undelivered love letters well over a decade overdue.

description.en:
After being caught in a bus accident caused by the aftermath of a collision between Earth and another world, a nearly forty-year-old man is given a choice: return to Earth with the accident erased, or begin a new life in another world with a special profession known as a Class.

With little tying him to his old life, he chooses the latter. However, the highest-ranking classes, “Hero” and “Great Sage,” have already been taken. Among the remaining top-tier choices, one particularly strange option catches his eye: “Potion Master.”

Tired of the hustle and bustle of city life, he figures making potions sounds perfect for a quiet and relaxing slow life.

There is just one problem: Potion Master turns out to be an absurdly broken class.

Before long, he uses one of his own potions to transform himself into a little witch, befriends a terrifying magical bear, and becomes far more involved in the affairs of this new world than any peaceful slow life should require.

And so begins the decidedly not-so-slow life of an overpowered little witch and her bear in another world.

Пока другие выбирают «Святых меча» и прочие боевые профессии, наш герой, уставший от шума и суеты мегаполиса, решает: «А почему бы и нет? Для спокойной жизни — самое то».

Он выбирает «Зельевара», воплощается в теле маленькой ведьмочки и готовится к тихому быту. Вот только он еще не знает, что этот класс на самом деле — абсолютная имба, ломающая все игровые условности этого мира!..

The story takes place in an ordinary Japanese town, Fuyuki City. Hidden from society, there has been a deadly war going on in this town. Seven mages known as "Masters" summon powerful familiars called "Servants" and they all fight each other until the last one. The last one is said to attain the Holy Grail which will grant them a wish. Only a few know when this War started and what the Holy Grail is, but the war is about to begin again this year.

The main character is Emiya Shirou, who lost his parents in a fire and was adopted by a man who called himself a mage. Admiring his stepfather, he has been training himself to be a mage. However, he had no talent and he could barely use one type of magecraft. His stepfather has already passed away, and today he is a mage without any skills or knowledge. He is involved in the Holy Grail War when he accidentally summons Saber, who is said to be the strongest Servant of all…
description.ru: Вот уже много лет продолжается война за Святой Грааль - священный артефакт, способный исполнять желания. Маги и их слуги, души великих героев из прошлого, сражаются до тех пор, пока не останется только один, единственно достойный Святой Чаши. Ареной боев был избран маленький японский городок - и в результате прошлой войны он сгорел почти дотла. И вот Эмия Широ, слабейший из избранных Граалем в новой войне чародеев, чьи родители погибли в том пожаре, случайно вызывает сильнейшего слугу… Исполненный желания не допустить подобного впредь, он вступает в бой, где его противники - бессмертные души и могущественные маги, где он может полагаться лишь на свою веру и могущество своего слуги… Адаптация эроге Fate/Stay Night от компании Type-Moon.

Sete magos conhecidos como "mestres" invocam poderosos familiares chamados de "servos" e todos eles lutam entre si até que o último sobre. O último é dito que irá alcançar o Santo Graal que lhes concederá um desejo. Poucos sabem quando esta guerra começou e o que é o Santo Graal, mas a guerra está prestes a começar outra vez este ano.

description.en:
In a world where aptitude for magic is determined by a crest. 

At the age of seven, Alec, the sixth prince of the sacred Luxian Empire, was given a crest of [Dark Magic], which is said to turn him into a demon as soon as he uses it. Scorned by those around him, Alec became a shut-in in the palace, and in the last days of his life, he used [Dark Magic], which he had never used before, in the hope of getting a good glimpse of it. 

However, Alec's crest was actually a special one that allowed him to use [Dark Magic] without having his body taken over by a demon! He died as he was - but when he woke up, he was back to his childhood! Reverting back to his seven-year-old self, Alec uses [Dark Magic] to turn all kinds of demons into his dependents, and together with his strongest companions, he builds an ideal country...!

description.en: Cross-dressing is the manliest act that only men can do!” Such is the unusual teaching of the sect known as the Cross-dressing School. Chiharu, a novice monk who just can’t get used to wearing women’s clothes, spends his days constantly being scolded. But one day, he falls in love at first sight with Komari, a real girl who visits the temple. To make things even more complicated, she calls his cross-dressed appearance “cute”!?

Mitsuhiko Amano is full of regrets. A 46 year old salaryman who had just been laid off, he was told that his wife wanted a divorce, something that he might have been wanting for years. So he visits a soapland, a place he hasn't been since he started dating his wife 22 years ago. While there, a fire suddenly erupts, trapping Amano and a soapland girl in the bath. In a rare moment of bravery and decisiveness, Amano attempts to lead the girl to safety, only to slip and hit his head. As his consciousness fades, he sees the back of the soapland girl making her escape… A fresh set of regret blankets him as he passes out, that his wife Sachiko and daughter Miyu will be objects of ridicule that he died in such a place…  
  
Then he awakens. In front of him is Ozawa Satsuki, a girl he hardly knew but secretly liked in high school. And Takahashi, Nakao-san, and Iijima-kun too. All his high school friends in their high school uniform, in their, and his, old high school… He has slipped 30 years into his past.  
  
Has he been given a second chance? To change his life so that the regrets that weighed him down never happen this time around?

Vampires are creatures that turn to ash if they are exposed to the light of the sun. He can only move around at night, but he's actually been able to live quite comfortably in modern times.

Why is that, you ask? That's because there exists the concept of a "night shift".

Toraki Yura is a vampire who lives in the modern age. He works at a convenience store in Ikebukuro (night shift only), and lives in a semi-basement apartment that gets next to no sunlight (blackout curtains are a necessity). For the sake of going back to being human, he lives his life on the straight and narrow everyday.

However, after saving a blond-haired beauty from a drunkard, he finds out that she is Sister Iris, a nun who found her calling in exterminating vampires! Moreover, his natural enemy ended up as an unwanted guest in his apartment!? What is going to happen to Toraki's peaceful vampire life!?

A slice-of-life fantasy brought to you by Wagahara Satoshi, author of the "Hataraku Maou-sama!" series!
description.id:
Vampir adalah makhluk yang berubah menjadi abu jika terkena cahaya matahari. Dia hanya bisa bergerak di malam hari, tapi dia sebenarnya sudah bisa hidup cukup nyaman di zaman modern ini.

Mengapa demikian, Anda bertanya? Itu karena ada konsep "shift malam".

Toraki Yura adalah seorang vampir yang hidup di zaman modern. Dia bekerja di sebuah toko serba ada di Ikebukuro (hanya shift malam), dan tinggal di apartemen semi-basement yang hampir tidak terkena sinar matahari (tirai gelap adalah kebutuhan). Demi kembali menjadi manusia, ia menjalani hidupnya dengan lurus dan sempit setiap hari.

Namun, setelah menyelamatkan kecantikan berambut pirang dari seorang pemabuk, dia mengetahui bahwa dia adalah Suster Iris, seorang biarawati yang menemukannya memanggilnya untuk membasmi vampir! Terlebih lagi, musuh alaminya berakhir sebagai tamu yang tidak diinginkan di apartemennya!? Apa yang akan terjadi pada kehidupan vampir damai Toraki!?

Sebuah fantasi irisan kehidupan yang dibawakan oleh Wagahara Satoshi, penulis "Hataraku Maou-sama!" seri!

description.en: In this story, unidentified giant weapons will destroy the world's metropolises in 2029. The masterminds of this unprecedented destruction are known as "Tokoshie". They call themselves weapons when they go out on the streets of the cities with their overwhelming powers and disappear as soon as they are done with them. A decade has passed since then. A certain military company is developing a combat drone with the ability to fight the Tokoshie, and a certain millionaire figure goes underground to discover the secret of the Tokoshie's eternal life. Another specific girl goes on a journey to fight the Tokoshie, sworn in as her parents' enemies. In short, this is the chronicle of an endless struggle between humanity and its greatest enemy ever.
description.ru:
Это история о том, как в 2029 году, неизвестное огромное оружие уничтожило мегаполисы мира. Организаторы этого беспрецедентного разрушения стали известны, как «Токоши». Они называют себя оружием, когда выходят на улицы городов со своей подавляющей силой, и исчезают, как только уничтожают их. С тех пор прошло десять лет.

Некая военная компания разрабатывает боевой дрон, способный сражаться с Токоши, и некий миллионер уходит в подполье, чтобы раскрыть секрет вечной жизни Токоши. Какая то девушка отправляется в путешествие, чтобы сразиться с Токоши, убившими её родителей. Короче говоря, это хроника бесконечной борьбы между человечеством и его величайшим врагом.
description.pt-br:
Nesta história, armas gigantes não identificadas destruíram as grandes cidades do mundo em 2030. Os mentores dessa destruição sem precedentes são conhecidos como “Tokoshie”. Eles se autodenominam armas quando saem para as ruas das cidades com seus poderes avassaladores e desaparecem assim que as destroem. Quase uma década se passa desde então. Uma certa companhia militar está desenvolvendo um drone de combate com habilidade para lutar contra os Tokoshie, e uma certa figura milionária parte em uma jornada subterrânea para descobrir o segredo da vida eterna deles. Outra garota específica parte em uma jornada para lutar contra os Tokoshie, declarados inimigos de seus pais. Em suma, esta é a crônica de uma luta sem limites entre a humanidade e seu maior inimigo de todos os tempos.
